title: Rename a zone
interactive: /…/zone-name → old name → new name (two quoted arguments in the journal)
notes: Both forms are used in the working journal: /define/boundary-conditions zone-name (for BC zones) and /mesh/modify-zones zone-name (for mesh zones); both are in the 2026 R1 menu. The argument order 'old → new' is confirmed by the journal.
